Description: The castle yard once bustled with traders; now only a few stalls remain.
This market stand smells of dried herbs and fresh bread, a rare comfort within stone walls.
Notice the statue — it honors a hero long forgotten by most, but still remembered here.
The notice board carries faded posters, some so old the ink has nearly vanished.
Lanterns swing gently in the breeze, guiding late travelers to the heart of the yard.
Behind these crates, children used to play while their parents traded. Now, only silence.
